from scipy.sparse import lil_matrix
from scipy.sparse.linalg import spsolve

def forward(k, gamma, sigma, xy, amp):
    n = len(k)
    h = 1/n
    a = lil_matrix((n*n,n*n))
    for i,j in np.ndindex(k.shape):
        p = i*n+j
        for u,v in [(i-1,j),(i+1,j),(i,j-1),(i,j+1)]:
            if 0 <= u < n and 0 <= v < n:
                w = 2/(1/k[i,j]+1/k[u,v])
                a[p,u*n+v] = -w
                a[p,p] += w
            else:
                a[p,p] += gamma*h
